title: Artifact Reduction in Undersampled 3D Cone-Beam CTs using a Hybrid 2D-3D CNN Framework
abstract: arXiv:2602.08727v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Undersampled CT volumes minimize acquisition time and radiation exposure but introduce artifacts degrading image quality and diagnostic utility. Reducing these artifacts is critical for high-quality imaging. We propose a computationally efficient hybrid deep-learning framework that combines the strengths of 2D and 3D models. First, a 2D U-Net operates on individual slices of undersampled CT volumes to extract feature maps. These slice-wise feature maps are then stacked across the volume and used as input to a 3D decoder, which utilizes contextual information across slices to predict an artifact-free 3D CT volume. The proposed two-stage approach balances the computational efficiency of 2D processing with the volumetric consistency provided by 3D modeling. translated_abstract: 欠采样CT体积能够最小化采集时间和辐射暴露，但会引入降低图像质量和诊断效用的伪影。减少这些伪影对于实现高质量成像至关重要。我们提出了一种计算高效的混合深度学习框架，结合了2D和3D模型的优势。首先，2D U-Net在欠采样CT体积的各个切片上运行以提取特征图。然后，这些切片级特征图在整个体积上堆叠，并作为3D解码器的输入，该解码器利用切片间的上下文信息来预测无伪影的3D CT体积。所提出的两阶段方法平衡了2D处理的计算效率与3D建模提供的体积一致性。结果表明，该方法在冠状面和矢状面方向的切片间一致性方面有显著改善，且计算开销较低。这种混合框架提供了一个稳健的
tldr: 提出一种混合2D-3D CNN框架，先用2D U-Net提取切片特征，再由3D解码器利用跨切片上下文信息，以较低计算开销高效去除欠采样3D锥束CT伪影并显著提升切片间一致性。
en_tdlr: A hybrid 2D-3D CNN framework is proposed, where a 2D U-Net extracts slice-wise features and a 3D decoder leverages cross-slice context to efficiently reduce artifacts in undersampled 3D cone-beam CTs while substantially improving inter-slice consistency with low computational overhead.
